title: AgentRoam
description: Buy travel eSIMs, gift cards and mobile top-ups with crypto — user confirms before any order.
summary: Buy travel eSIMs, gift cards and mobile top-ups with crypto — user confirms before any order.
offersHint: Buy travel eSIMs, gift cards and mobile top-ups with crypto — user confirms before any order. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://agentroam.ai/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_products
toolsPreview.description: Search the AgentRoam travel-crypto catalog: gift cards (Airbnb, Uber, airlines, 500+ US brands), eSIM data plans (110+ destinations incl. Europe/Global region plans) and mobile top-ups (carriers in 100+ countries). Returns product handles for get_price/validate_order. Never creates an order.

toolsPreview.name: get_price
toolsPreview.description: Live crypto price for one product/denomination. Payment coins include USDT, USDC, BTC (incl. Lightning), ETH, SOL, DAI, PYUSD, LTC, TRX, TON, DOGE and SUI across many networks — call get_payment_methods for the current list. Never creates an order.

toolsPreview.name: validate_order
toolsPreview.description: Dry-run an order and mint a one-time confirm_token (valid 10 minutes). Returns a human-readable summary that MUST be shown to the user for approval before calling create_order. Does NOT create the order or reserve funds.

toolsPreview.name: create_order
toolsPreview.description: Create the real order (requires confirm_token from validate_order, after user approval). Returns the payment wallet address, exact crypto amount, 30-minute expiry, and an order-status URL. The purchased code/QR is emailed by Cryptorefills to the buyer — it is never returned here.

toolsPreview.name: list_esim_plans
toolsPreview.description: PREFERRED for any eSIM request: live eSIM data plans for a destination (110+ countries, plus "eu" Europe and "ww" Global multi-country plans) with USD prices and crypto amounts. Renders an interactive plan-picker widget where the user can complete the purchase directly. Never creates an order by itself.

toolsPreview.name: get_order_status
toolsPreview.description: Poll order state (WAITING_FOR_PAYMENT → PARTIAL → COMPLETED, or CANCELED/EXPIRED). Requires the status_token from create_order.

toolsPreview.name: list_brands
toolsPreview.description: Browse all available brands/carriers for a country: gift cards (500+ US brands) and mobile top-up carriers (100+ countries). Never creates an order.

toolsPreview.name: list_products
toolsPreview.description: List a brand's live products/denominations with prices in the chosen coin — exact labels to use with get_price/validate_order (for eSIM use list_esim_plans instead). Never creates an order.

toolsPreview.name: get_currencies
toolsPreview.description: List all supported payment cryptocurrencies (the response carries the current set).

toolsPreview.name: get_payment_methods
toolsPreview.description: Full payment matrix: every supported coin × network combination currently available, with the exact network strings orders require. The response includes live totals — report those, never a memorized count.

toolsPreview.name: purchase_wizard
toolsPreview.description: Text-only fallback purchase flow for clients WITHOUT widget support. In ChatGPT prefer list_esim_plans / list_products + validate_order + create_order instead. Stateful: call repeatedly with the same session_token, answering one question at a time, until status is "complete". First call: empty arguments. The final "confirm" answer creates a REAL order — get explicit user approval first.
